entries.name: resource_background_decoder_iwram
entries.evidence: Matching installer 0x08016a48 publishes destination 0x03003370 to callback word 0x030036c0; source/destination/control literals establish the 848-byte copy. The first 812 ROM bytes are source-owned assembly-origin resource_background_decoder; the following 36 bytes belong to matching C frame_schedule.

entries.name: frame_map_draw_iwram
entries.evidence: Matching installer 0x08039e78 publishes even destination 0x03007160 to callback word 0x03001fc8. Source/destination/control literals establish the 336-byte copy: 320-byte matching C frame_stage_map_tiles plus 16 source bytes of matching C frame_transfer_map_tiles. Compatible one-argument source interface uses the low byte of view_index; complete index, writer and incoming-entry populations remain open.

entries.name: frame_map_scroll_iwram
entries.evidence: Matching installer 0x08039e78 publishes destination 0x03005e60 to callback word 0x03001fcc; source/destination/control literals establish the 228-byte copy. The first 216 bytes are matching C frame_transfer_map_tiles at its RAM link address; the following 12 ROM source bytes belong to matching C display_find_tile_run. View argument is narrowed to a byte; allowed indices remain unresolved.

entries.name: audio_sample_active_ram
entries.evidence: Copied audio image from startup installs ROM 0xFDAA40 at RAM 0x030005C8. Standalone instrument starter loads this ARM address and calls it through r7. The complete 56-byte handle/activity check including its pool matches C at the RAM execution address; the following four-byte counter storage remains explicit data.
